research_subject: 特斯拉（北美业务）：回本之路尚需耐心等待
executive_summary: 摩根士丹利报告指出，特斯拉正加速资本开支以确立自动驾驶与机器人领导地位，FSD北美附着率远超预估达55%，Robotaxi与Optimus虽进展积极但分别受限于软件校准与供应链复杂度。沉重资本开支令自由现金流进一步转负，目标价从417美元下调至400美元，维持Equal-weight评级。报告认为回报实现需耐心与持续执行，投资者应重点关注现有城市内Robotaxi密度与安全数据积累、Optimus商业化切实进展等证明点，以评估资本开支回报时机与容忍度。
key_findings: FSD北美附着率在二季度达55%，远超此前预估的25-30%
重资本开支周期使自由现金流持续转负，2027年预计FCF burn达约14亿美元
Robotaxi与Optimus进展积极，但受限于软件校准与供应链复杂度
目标价从417美元下调至400美元，维持Equal-weight评级

data_points.context: 此前目标价为417美元，下调反映资本开支增加导致自由现金流恶化
此前预估为-5亿美元，大幅恶化因资本开支增加至近30亿美元
因能源业务利润率承压及研发持续增长

evidence.claim: FSD北美附着率远超预估
evidence.quote: FSD adoption was an upside surprise, with North America attach rates reaching 55% in the quarter, far surpassing our 25-30% estimate.

evidence.claim: 重资本开支周期使自由现金流持续转负
evidence.quote: The capex step-up is a known trend, now confirmed and extended for the next 2-3 years, prolonging cash burn through the end of the decade on our estimates.

evidence.claim: Robotaxi进展受软件校准限制
evidence.quote: Cybercab production is scaling, but software recalibration limits near-term fleet entry.

evidence.claim: Optimus商业化受供应链复杂度制约
evidence.quote: Optimus SOP is expected soon. Supply chain complexities elongate the initial ramp.

research_subject: 欧元区能源价格上行，抵消此前通胀回落成效
executive_summary: 高盛利用大型贝叶斯向量自回归模型分析发现，受中东军事冲突与俄罗斯炼油中断影响，欧元区能源价格再度上涨，其直接传导效应强劲但未见二轮工资效应，且此前偏软的价格数据带来的通胀低于欧央行预测0.4和0.2个百分点的进展已被抵消。模型估算显示，能源价格回升使通胀峰值预测与欧央行基线重新对齐，表明近期通胀回落成效被侵蚀。报告建议预期欧洲央行管委会于9月会议第二次加息，且若能源价格持续高企使前景恶化，进一步收紧政策的风险偏上行。

executive_summary: 伯恩斯坦复盘德州仪器二季度业绩指出，营收54.63亿美元、每股收益2.14美元、毛利率61.4%均超市场预期，工业、数据中心与汽车业务分别实现约30%、翻倍及双位数同比增长，且营收指引59亿美元与利润率指引亦高于共识，资本开支维持20-30亿美元区间。伯恩斯坦据此上调盈利预估并将目标价由250美元升至290美元（对应约30倍远期市盈率），但维持“市场表现”评级，认为股价已充分估值。分析师建议投资者因估值偏高转向其他领域，并关注工业周期持续性、数据中心业务规模化及季节性预期偏差等风险。

research_subject: Alphabet（GOOG.US）：资本开支上调抢走风头，但云业务加速强劲；重申“买入”
executive_summary: 美银指出Alphabet二季度净营收1036亿美元超市场预期，云业务加速至82%增长，积压订单达5140亿美元，但资本开支上调至1950-2050亿美元引发短期股价承压。美银上调2027年净营收3%至5530亿美元、EPS 2%至15.01美元，维持买入评级及430美元目标价。认为云需求强劲、搜索稳健及AI差异化支撑长期增长，估值具吸引力。
key_findings: 云业务二季度增长82%远超市场预期65%，积压订单环比增11%至5140亿美元
资本开支上调约8%至1950-2050亿美元，预计2026年自由现金流为负160亿美元
上调2027年净营收3%至5530亿美元、EPS 2%至15.01美元
维持买入评级及430美元目标价，认为估值约22倍2027年GAAP EPS具吸引力

data_points.context: 超市场预期的1011亿美元，由云业务超预期驱动
市场预期为65%，加速19个百分点
上调150亿美元（约8%），因加速数据中心建设
上调2%，净营收上调3%至5530亿美元
维持买入评级，基于27倍2027年核心GAAP EPS加每股现金

evidence.claim: 云业务加速强劲且积压订单大增
evidence.quote: 2Q Cloud revenue at $24.8bn (up 82% y/y) was above Street at $22.5bn (up 65% y/y). Google Cloud operating income increased to $8.8bn and operating margin increased to 35.6% (vs Street 31.3%).

evidence.claim: 资本开支上调但云回报强化
evidence.quote: To meet capacity demand, Google is accelerating capacity deployment and increased its FY26 capex guide by $15bn (~8%) to $195bn-$205bn.

evidence.claim: 维持买入评级及目标价
evidence.quote: Reiterate Rating: BUY | PO: 430.00 USD | Price: 342.09 USD

evidence.claim: 估值具吸引力
evidence.quote: At the $332 AH price, GOOG is valued at ~22x our higher '27 GAAP EPS est, in line with historical avg despite recent acceleration.

research_subject: 全球数字资产｜新兴AI基建：“第三方算力”行情仍有支撑
executive_summary: 伯恩斯坦指出新兴AI基础设施提供商（前比特币矿工）通过签订超7.5GW、1500亿美元第三方算力托管合同成为解决算力短缺关键力量，电力获取与交付能力为核心壁垒。行业订单势头强劲、经济效益改善（三重净租赁近100%利润率、合同延至15-20年），多家企业已按时启动初期交付。板块获整体超重配评级，建议聚焦具备执行兑现与稳定客户关系的头部企业，并关注监管与电网约束。
key_findings: 新兴AI基建商已签约约7.5GW、超1500亿美元第三方算力合同，7月每周有新交易
三重净租赁带来近100%利润率，近期合同期限延长至15-20年
WULF、IREN等已按时启动初期容量交付，预计H2'26交付加速
板块获伯恩斯坦整体超重配评级，看好奇迹WULF、IREN等头部企业

data_points.context: 对应超1500亿美元多年期合同
跨3笔托管租约， securing $35Bn总合同值

比特币矿工未指示成本超支

evidence.claim: 新兴AI基建商签约规模庞大且行情有支撑
evidence.quote: Emerging AI Infra stocks (former crypto miners) continue to see strong investor interest with a series of new deals announced in recent weeks. Our industry deals tracker for miners has seen a new deal every week in July, with combined deals standing at over 7.5GW contracted equivalent to $150Bn multi-year contracts.

evidence.claim: 三重净租赁改善经济效益
evidence.quote: Under triple net leases, tenant bears power, operating costs, taxes and insurance, effectively generating ~100% NOI margin for the landlord.

evidence.claim: 交付按时推进
evidence.quote: We expect delivery pace to pick up in H2'26 with WULF (delivering 378 IT MW to Fluidstack), CORZ (scaling to 450 IT MW with CoreWeave) and CIFR starting phased delivery of AWS and Fluidstack contracts.

evidence.claim: 板块获超重配评级
evidence.quote: We are overweight on the sector, although, we are watching closely for which management teams break out on execution and durable client relationships.

research_subject: Alphabet（GOOG.US）：营收增长预期早已被市场充分定价
executive_summary: 瑞银称Alphabet搜索与云增长符合预期、云积压订单达5100亿美元且YouTube广告超预期，但资本支出与薪酬成本上升拖累利润率，近期每股收益受股权重估提振。瑞银微修营收预测但上调成本假设，下调未来三年EPS预期，并将目标价从400美元降至379美元维持中性。鉴于近峰值倍数、盈利下修可能及生成式AI竞争威胁，认为风险回报偏中性。
key_findings: 云积压订单达5100亿美元，高于瑞银预测的4820亿美元
资本支出指引上调至1950-2050亿美元，高于共识1865亿美元
下调2026-2028年EPS预期，目标价从400美元降至379美元
维持中性评级，认为近峰值倍数与盈利下修风险使风险回报偏中性

上调150亿美元，高于共识1865亿美元
此前为400美元，基于26倍3Q27-2Q28E GAAP稀释EPS 14.64美元
高于共识2.88美元，受股权重估提振

evidence.claim: 云积压订单超预期
evidence.quote: Google reported better-than-expected Cloud backlog, which hit about $510B as of 2Q26 close vs ~$462B at 1Q26 close. For context, we were modeling $482B in backlog for 2Q26.

evidence.claim: 资本支出上调拖累利润率
evidence.quote: Google guided CapEx at $195B-$205B versus $180B-$190B earlier and compared to consensus at $186.5B and UBSe at $196.2B.

evidence.claim: 下调目标价维持中性
evidence.quote: We reduce our price target on GOOGL as well as GOOG to $379 (from $400 prior) based on 26x (unchanged) our full year ending 2Q28E GAAP diluted EPS of $14.64 (vs $15.16 prior).

evidence.claim: 风险回报偏中性
evidence.quote: We keep our Neutral rating as there are wide potential impacts to Google's businesses from competition and other factors.

research_subject: IPO井喷，是市场的红色警报吗？
executive_summary: 高盛Top of Mind第150期探讨2026年美国IPO市场重新开放且发行量创纪录高位，引发是否为晚期周期警报及市场能否消化新供给的担忧。专家认为按交易数量计尚非真正浪潮，估值与供需总体健康。Snider认为晚期周期警告信号薄弱，Ritter指历史红灯信号弱，Lamont谨慎视IPO浪潮为泡沫征兆之一但不预示顶部。共识关注首日回报与AI前景，建议优选IPO组合而非单个标的。
key_findings: 2026年美股IPO发行额年内已达约1250亿美元，超越2021年全年约1200亿美元纪录，预计全年超2000亿美元
按交易数量看年内约60家，远低于泡沫期水平，专家称尚非真正IPO浪潮
高盛Snider认为晚期周期警告信号不明显，市场可消化新供给；Lamont视IPO浪潮为泡沫四骑士之一但未必预示顶部
历史IPO后数年倾向跑输，建议持有IPO组合而非单押，关注锁定期到期与AI前景

data_points.context: 超越2021年全年约1200亿美元纪录
同比增超50%，但接近长期均值

data_points.value_text: 约1.6万亿美元（分红6000亿+回购1万亿）
data_points.context: Ritter称IPO仅吸收其中一小部分

evidence.claim: 当前IPO发行额创纪录但数量未达泡沫水平
evidence.quote: In dollar terms, 2026 is already a record year for the US IPO market. New issuance has totaled around $125bn year to date, surpassing the previous full-year record of around $120bn in 2021.

evidence.claim: 高盛Snider认为晚期周期警告信号薄弱
evidence.quote: I'm less worried [about the surge in new issuance] than the average investor... the late-cycle warning signs that have historically accompanied IPO booms aren't evident today

evidence.claim: Lamont谨慎视IPO浪潮为泡沫征兆
evidence.quote: he views an issuance wave as one of the 'four horsemen' of a bubble... but stresses that IPO waves don't necessarily signal the market top

evidence.claim: 历史IPO倾向跑输，建议持有组合
evidence.quote: an equal-weighted portfolio of IPOs has generally outperformed the broader market over time—and why, if history repeats as I expect, investors are likely better served owning a portfolio of IPOs rather than trying to pick a single winner

research_subject: 空客（AIR.PA）：中期指引、50亿欧元回购及2029年后发展路径
executive_summary: 德银指出空客披露符合预期的中期指引，并宣布50亿欧元三年期股票回购计划，宽体客机、服务及防务直升机业务预计2029年后保持增长。德银将目标价从226欧元上调至232欧元，维持买入评级，认为回购向股东返还约60%自由现金流是积极信号，商业增长不会在2029年持平。公司确认2026指引，2029年调整后EBIT指引为120-130亿欧元。
key_findings: 空客宣布50亿欧元三年期股票回购，返还约60%自由现金流
2029年中期指引：调整后EBIT 120-130亿欧元，共识为130亿欧元
宽体客机、服务及防务直升机业务预计2029年后继续增长
德银上调目标价至232欧元（原226欧元），维持买入评级

data_points.context: 除30%-50%股息支付政策外，返还约60%自由现金流
当前目标，2026年决定进一步增产至14-16架
2025至2030年翻倍，通过有机增长和并购

evidence.quote: At its business update, Airbus confirmed its 2026 guidance and disclosed a 2029 mid-term guidance, with an adjusted EBIT of €12-13bn in 2029 versus the Bloomberg consensus of €13bn.

evidence.claim: 宣布50亿欧元回购返还自由现金流
evidence.quote: More importantly, it announced a much-anticipated €5bn share buyback program over three years, in addition to the 30%-50% dividend payout policy disclosed in 2025. This policy to return approximately 60% of FCF to shareholders should be seen as a positive, in our view.

evidence.claim: 2029年后增长由宽体和服务驱动
evidence.quote: Widebody ramp-up is expected to continue beyond 2029, with a decision anticipated in 2026 to further increase the A350 production rate.

evidence.claim: 德银上调目标价并维持买入
evidence.quote: We raised our PT from €226 to €232 mainly as the result of the buyback programme on share count.

executive_summary: 美银证券发布亚马逊业绩前瞻，将AWS营收增速预期上调至33%（原31%），预计二季度总营收1988亿美元、营业利润241亿美元均高于市场共识，主因AI合作驱动云需求。零售预期与共识一致，AWS超预期。预计三季度营收指引2005-2055亿美元、营业利润215-265亿美元，与共识基本持平。重申买入评级，目标价310美元，提示资本开支上升与利润率压力等风险。
key_findings: 上调AWS二季度增速预期至33%（原31%），预计营收409.99亿美元
预计二季度总营收1988.16亿美元、GAAP营业利润241.49亿美元，均高于Street
预计三季度营收指引2005-2055亿美元，营业利润215-265亿美元，与Street基本持平
重申买入评级，目标价310美元，潜在风险为更高2026 capex及2Q margin压力

data_points.context: 从31%上调，受Anthropic相关营收及OpenAI模型推动Bedrock需求

evidence.claim: 上调AWS增速预期并预计二季度超预期
evidence.quote: we now estimate 2Q revenue/EBIT of $198.8bn/$24.1bn, above Street at $196.8bn/$23.6bn. We are raising our AWS growth est. to 33% y/y from 31%

evidence.claim: 预计三季度指引与市场共识基本持平
evidence.quote: For 3Q, we expect rev. guidance at $200.5bn-$205.5bn (+2% q/q at midpoint vs BofA), which compares to Street at $204bn.

evidence.claim: 重申买入评级及目标价
evidence.quote: Reiterate Rating: BUY | PO: 310.00 USD | Price: 249.99 USD

evidence.claim: AWS AI定位改善支撑盈利前景
evidence.quote: We remain constructive on AWS's improving AI positioning, which should be apparent in results that show AWS growth acceleration, backlog expansion ($100bn of Anthropic backlog in 2Q)

research_subject: 德州仪器（TXN.US）：业绩与指引强劲，印证模拟芯片复苏延续
executive_summary: 高盛指出德州仪器二季度营收54.63亿美元、每股收益2.14美元、毛利率61.4%均超市场预期，工业与汽车端需求改善印证模拟芯片行业复苏延续，但高库存致毛利率复苏慢于同业。高盛维持相对卖出评级，将12个月目标价从200美元上调至225美元，预期股价区间震荡，建议优先选择Microchip、NXP等毛利修复更快的同业标的。
key_findings: 二季度营收54.63亿美元、EPS 2.14美元、毛利率61.4%均超市场预期与高盛预期
工业与汽车端需求改善印证模拟芯片行业复苏延续，但高库存致毛利率复苏慢于同业
高盛维持相对卖出评级，将12个月目标价从200美元上调至225美元
建议优先选择Microchip、NXP等毛利修复更快的同业标的而非德州仪器

data_points.context: 高于GS 5,380百万美元及Street 5,262百万美元
高于GS 5,649百万美元及Street 5,626百万美元
此前为200美元，基于25倍P/E及 normalized EPS 9.00美元

evidence.claim: 二季度业绩超市场预期
evidence.quote: TI reported 2Q26 revenue of $5.46 bn, above GS at $5.38 bn and the Street (Visible Alpha) at $5.26 bn. Gross margin of 61.4% was well above GS at 59.4% and the Street at 59.5%. EPS of $2.14 was above GS at $1.99 and the Street at $1.94.

evidence.claim: 工业与汽车需求改善印证模拟芯片复苏
evidence.quote: We see the strong recovery in the industrial end market, as well as the beginning of broadening automotive demand improvement, as a particularly encouraging read-across for the sector.

evidence.claim: 毛利率复苏慢于同业，维持相对卖出
evidence.quote: We continue to have a preference for peers (including Microchip and NXP) who are likely to see greater upward earnings revisions in the near term, and we retain our relative Sell rating on TXN given the ongoing gross margin headwinds we expect in the coming quarters.

evidence.claim: 上调目标价但基于估值维持卖出
evidence.quote: We raise our 12-month price target to $225 (from $200 previously) is based on a 25X P/E multiple (unchanged) applied to our normalized EPS estimate of $9.00 (from $8.00 previously on higher estimates).

research_subject: IT硬件与通信设备：AT&T资本开支及iPhone销售数据解读
executive_summary: 巴克莱解读AT&T二季度财报，其智能手机销量与iPhone出货量均同比持平，设备升级率下滑至3.2%，季度资本开支57亿美元略高于市场预期55亿美元，全年指引维持230-240亿美元。对苹果影响中性偏谨慎，维持减持评级；光通信支出优先级提升，看好Ciena增持。报告认为北美电信运营商活动正常化，光纤扩张逐步恢复，光学支出将加速。
key_findings: AT&T二季度智能手机销量5.2M同比持平，iPhone出货量估3.4M同比持平、环比降个位数
设备升级率降至3.2%（前季3.5%），因补贴热情消退

维持苹果减持、Ciena增持、AT&T/思科/康宁持平权重评级

data_points.context: 同比持平、环比降个位数
高于预期5.5B，全年指引230-240亿美元不变
基于50x FY28 EPS 12.14美元，Overweight评级

evidence.claim: 二季度资本开支高于预期但全年指引不变

evidence.quote: We continue to believe optical spend for capacity enhancements will be prioritized and expect CIEN's business with major US telcos to accelerate into next year.

evidence.claim: 维持苹果减持评级
evidence.quote: We rate AAPL Underweight with a price target of $253.

research_subject: 基础设施软件：二季度业绩前瞻：首选标的：DDOG、SNOW、FROG、MDB、DT
executive_summary: 美银全球研究指出基础设施软件板块将成为AI应用最大受益领域，选定Datadog、Snowflake、JFrog、MongoDB和Dynatrace为首推标的，因其关键增长指标持续加速且AI受益逻辑清晰。基于行业调研与数据信号，预期上述标的将展现AI驱动的消费增长与业绩重估，上调多数覆盖公司价格目标。C3.ai与PagerDuty因管理层及定价转型面临预期下调风险，整体看好板块估值扩张潜力。
key_findings: 基础设施软件被视作AI应用四大软件板块中最大受益领域，首选DDOG、SNOW、FROG、MDB、DT
DDOG、SNOW、FROG关键增长指标加速，MDB本季有望证明AI受益，DT将兑现增长承诺
C3.ai与PagerDuty因转型面临最高预期下调风险，美银维持低配
上调DDOG、DT、FROG、SNOW等目标价，板块估值倍数扩张

此前300美元，基于16.2x EV/CY27E revenue

evidence.claim: 基础设施软件为AI最大受益板块且选定首选标的
evidence.quote: We think the 2Q earnings cycle will show infrastructure software to be the biggest AI beneficiary of the four software sectors we cover (the others being applications, vertical, and cybersecurity).

evidence.claim: DDOG增长加速且估值溢价合理
evidence.quote: We think there is a meaningful amount of scarcity value in DDOG, as it is clearly an AI beneficiary and growth should continue inflecting higher.

evidence.claim: MDB本季有望成为AI受益催化剂
evidence.quote: The biggest question we've heard since MDB's 1Q print is when it will prove out as an AI beneficiary. We think it will happen this quarter.

evidence.claim: C3.ai与PagerDuty面临下调风险
evidence.quote: On the other side, we see the highest risk of downward estimate revisions for C3.ai (AI) and PagerDuty (PD) given transitions across mgmt., go-to-market, and pricing models.

research_subject: “时间亿万富翁”渴望更高风险，AI是幕后推手吗？
executive_summary: 德银主题研究探讨预期寿命超10亿秒的年轻投资者（时间亿万富翁）普遍渴望增加投资风险并依赖AI管理资产的现象。专有数据显示美英55岁以下群体风险容忍度与AI依赖提升意愿突出，且年龄越小增险意愿越强。但该趋势与低迷消费者情绪、全球系统性风险加剧及反AI舆论增强形成矛盾。报告未提具体投资建议，仅指出行为心理与环境产物导致利弊共存，需理性权衡。
key_findings: 时间亿万富翁（预期寿命超10亿秒）希望获得更多风险及由AI管理资产
美英55岁以下群体特别渴望增加风险容忍度与AI依赖，年龄越小增险意愿越强
增险意愿与低迷消费者情绪、全球系统性风险加剧及反AI舆论增强形成矛盾
报告未提出具体投资建议，仅指出该趋势利弊共存需理性权衡

data_points.metric: 时间亿万富翁定义阈值
data_points.context: 预期寿命超此值即被视为时间亿万富翁

evidence.claim: 时间亿万富翁渴望更多风险与AI管理
evidence.quote: And as the number of younger investors increases, and their time horizons span 30, 40, or 50 years, they want two things: 1) More risk than they have today, 2) AI to manage their money and trade for them.

evidence.claim: 美英55岁以下群体增险与AI依赖意愿突出
evidence.quote: We highlight that both Americans and Britons under the age of 55 are particularly keen to increase (relative to today) both their risk tolerance and their dependence on AI to manage their portfolio.

evidence.claim: 增险意愿与多项负面环境矛盾
evidence.quote: The first is that it is intriguing that consumer sentiment is so low at the same time that the average person wants to take on more investment risk. A second is that this desire for risk at a household level comes as experts increasingly point to intensifying global systemic risks. A third is that the willingness to turn to AI for investment advice comes as the social winds against AI more broadly are growing in strength.

research_subject: 英伟达（NVDA.OQ）：更多核心还是更快核心？英伟达与AMD关于代理式AI CPU的路径之争
executive_summary: 美银指出英伟达与AMD在1700亿美元服务器CPU市场上就代理式AI发展路径产生分歧：英伟达Vera CPU采用88个定制ARM核心与单片设计强调高单线程性能，AMD则依托EPYC芯片粒架构主张在固定功耗下通过更多核心实现更高并发。争论延伸至x86与ARM生态差异。美银维持英伟达买入评级与350美元目标价，建议关注CPU关键性能指标定义权归属及架构长期演化。
key_findings: 英伟达Vera CPU采用88个定制ARM核心与单片设计，强调高单线程性能以优化延迟与GPU利用率
AMD依托EPYC芯片粒架构主张在固定功耗下通过更多核心实现更高并发，建模显示2.4至3.3倍机架级优势
争论延伸至x86与ARM企业软件生态差异，投资者需判断代理式AI受限于任务完成时间还是每机架代理数量
美银维持英伟达买入评级与350美元目标价，AMD公开技术回应预计侧重建立行业首选性能指标

data_points.context: 预计至2030年该市场可4倍成长
维持买入评级，价格207.29美元

evidence.claim: 英伟达与AMD在服务器CPU市场就代理式AI路径产生核心分歧
evidence.quote: 英伟达与AMD在预期规模达1700亿美元的服务器CPU市场上就代理式AI发展路径产生核心分歧：英伟达Vera CPU采用88个定制ARM核心与单片设计强调高单线程性能以优化延迟与GPU利用率，AMD则依托EPYC芯片粒架构主张在固定功耗下通过更多核心实现更高并发吞吐量（建模显示2.4至3.3倍机架级优势）。

evidence.claim: 英伟达主张更快核心优于更多核心
evidence.quote: NVDA's core argument is that agentic AI consists of repeated CPU → GPU loops involving tool calls, code execution, retrieval and orchestration, where each step depends on completion of the previous one. In this framework, faster per-core performance directly improves agent response times, GPU utilization and overall AI-factory productivity.

evidence.claim: AMD主张更多核心优于更快核心
evidence.quote: AMD argues production AI increasingly resembles a distributed software platform composed of databases, APIs, vector stores, orchestration engines, caches and middleware. In this environment, the primary constraint becomes the number of concurrent workflows that can be sustained inside a fixed power envelope.

evidence.claim: 美银维持英伟达买入评级与350美元目标价
evidence.quote: 美银维持英伟达买入评级与350美元目标价，建议投资者关注CPU关键性能指标定义权归属及双方架构在AI工厂实际生产效率中的长期演化。

executive_summary: 摩根大通报告指出上周散户资金流低于12个月均值，ETF流入疲软至4%分位而单股活动走强至71.8%分位，动量因子因极端拥挤出现回撤14%并频现极端负sigma事件。散户持续增持AI数据中心、超大规模云厂商及通信科技股，聚焦 hyperscaler 财报中AI货币化与回报等摇摆因素，并警惕高卖空仓位与散户买入并存的迷因股挤压风险。

research_subject: 特斯拉（TSLA.US）：核心市场业务与技术进展、投资成本仍为焦点；二季度业绩复盘
executive_summary: 高盛复盘特斯拉二季度业绩，非GAAP EPS为0.33美元远低于预期，汽车与能源毛利下滑及费用上升为主因。FSD北美附着率55%、robotaxi安全里程累积，但Optimus量产平缓且资本开支将持续增加。高盛维持中性评级，下调2026-2028年EPS预估及12个月目标价至360美元，认为估值已充分且竞争与研发需求限制盈利改善。
key_findings: 二季度非GAAP EPS 0.33美元，低于GS预期0.58及共识0.55，因汽车与能源毛利下滑、费用上升
FSD北美新车上险附着率达55%，robotaxi累计付费里程近250万英里，但Optimus量产平缓
资本开支预计未来2-3年继续上升，2026年超250亿美元，压制短期自由现金流
高盛维持中性评级，下调12个月目标价至360美元（原390美元），下调2026-2028年EPS预估

data_points.context: 同比增25.5%，低于GS预期28,478百万美元
此前为390美元，基于150倍市盈率

evidence.claim: 二季度业绩不及预期因毛利与费用压力
evidence.quote: Tesla's 2Q non-GAAP EPS came in below both consensus estimates and our expectation driven by lower margins. This included from lower gross margins in the Automotive and Energy segments, as well as from higher opex.

evidence.claim: FSD北美附着率创新高
evidence.quote: FSD take-rates in North America were a record 55% in the quarter on new vehicle deliveries.

evidence.claim: Optimus量产平缓且资本开支续增
evidence.quote: Tesla also described Optimus as being a complex technical challenge with a likely quite flat and long initial ramp on the S-curve. In addition, the scale of Tesla's robotaxi fleet is still small relative to some competitors. Finally, on the cost to fund these investments, the company suggested capex could rise for another two to three years, and that its opex is also likely to increase.

evidence.claim: 维持中性评级并下调目标价
evidence.quote: We maintain our Neutral rating on the stock. We continue to believe that Tesla can benefit over time from its opportunities in several large markets, including autonomy, robotics, EVs and energy. However, the trajectory to that better profitability/FCF appears somewhat lower than we had previously expected over the near-to-medium term given headwinds to margins in 2Q and ongoing planned increases in investments in both opex and capex. We lower our 12-month price target to $360 from $390.

evidence.claim: 日本股市回调后估值合理且盈利支撑强
evidence.quote: Japan market saw sharp de-rating since June, dropping from 17x forward P/E to 14.9x fwd. PE now, which is 10yr average multiples. Hence, valuation is no longer a challenge while earnings upgrade cycle continues.

evidence.claim: 行业评分看多半导体等、看淡医药等
evidence.quote: Our updated industry scorecard based on multiple fundamental parameters such as sales growth, margins, earnings, ROE, capex, valuations and balance sheet is showing bullish outlook for Semis, Automobiles & Components, Capital Goods, Household & Personal Products, Energy, Banks, Diversified Financials and Insurance.

evidence.claim: 维持价值与成长杠铃策略
evidence.quote: We maintain our value and growth barbell. Leadership in 2026 has been driven by growth/momentum factors, while quality, low volatility and small Caps have lagged.

evidence.claim: 出口与本土均衡配置且本土案例改善
evidence.quote: We have been recommending balanced exposure across exporters and domestics. Given these mixed signals, we maintain our preference for both exporters and domestics, though we believe the case for domestics is improving as extreme weak Yen support for exporters is largely behind us.

executive_summary: 高盛指出GE Vernova二季度电气化业务销售额36.37亿美元、EBITDA 6.71亿美元均超预期，订单同比增93%至63.47亿美元，上调全年销售指引至145-150亿美元。电网产品需求强劲且数据中心相关订单上半年超50亿美元，对相似业务的日立能源形成利好。高盛对日立维持买入评级，12个月目标价6300日元，基于13倍EV/EBITDA。

电网设备需求强劲，1H FY26数据中心相关订单超50亿美元，超FY25全年水平

evidence.claim: 电网需求强劲且数据中心订单突出

research_subject: 中国CDMO：多肽CDMO基础深度解析（上篇）：供给端龙头在产能规模、成本水平与技术覆盖面形成差异化优势
executive_summary: 伯恩斯坦发布多肽CDMO深度解析上篇，聚焦供给端，指出行业碎片化但呈规模化平台主导趋势，分为多元化CRDMO、专业多肽龙头及新兴供应商三类。中国CRDMO是GLP-1热潮主要受益者，药明康德在产能、利润率、技术布局多维领先，凯莱英高增长。2025年top4多肽CDMO收入从2021年约10亿美元增至30亿美元，药明康德TIDES份额达54%。报告给予药明康德、凯莱英跑赢大盘评级，药明生物市场表现评级。
key_findings: 多肽CDMO行业碎片化，分为多元化CRDMO、专业多肽龙头、新兴供应商三类，中国CRDMO是GLP-1主要受益者
药明康德2025年TIDES收入17亿美元，多肽产量估58吨，毛利率约47%、EBIT利润率37%领先同业
前四大多肽CDMO收入从2021年约10亿美元增至2025年30亿美元，药明康德份额由11%升至54%
给予药明康德和凯莱英跑赢大盘评级，药明生物为市场表现评级

data_points.metric: 药明康德毛利率与EBIT利润率

evidence.claim: 行业碎片化且中国CRDMO受益GLP-1
evidence.quote: The peptide CDMO landscape spans three groups: diversified CRDMOs - Thermo Fisher and WuXi AppTec among others, specialty peptide leaders - Bachem, PolyPeptide, CordenPharma, and a long tail of emerging suppliers. Chinese CRDMOs have been the primary beneficiaries of the GLP-1 boom.

evidence.claim: 药明康德规模与利润领先
evidence.quote: WuXi AppTec generates industry-leading margins with approximately 47% gross margin and 37% EBIT margin, compared with roughly 22% EBIT margin at Bachem

evidence.claim: 药明康德份额快速提升
evidence.quote: WuXi AppTec has been the largest beneficiary, with TIDES revenue increasing from c.$120 Mn in 2021 to $1.7 Bn in 2025 with over 70% compound growth, driving market share from 11% to 54%

evidence.claim: 评级结论
evidence.quote: The report ultimately gives WuXi AppTec and Asymchem outperformance ratings, WuXi Biologics a market perform rating.

research_subject: 日本科技行业｜半导体设备：6月SEAJ数据：前端设备引领强劲需求；上调盈利预测；推荐买入Lasertec、Ebara、Disco、东京电子
executive_summary: 高盛基于SEAJ于7月21日收盘后发布的2026年6月数据，指出日本半导体生产设备4-6月月均销售5136亿日元（同比+27%、环比+7.0%），FY3/27需求预测上调至6.55万亿日元（+26% yoy）。前端设备需求成为增长核心，应用广泛。高盛上调盈利预测，维持Lasertec、Ebara、Disco、东京电子买入评级，并因日元假设调整由155升至160。

前端设备需求强劲，覆盖HBM、先进逻辑、商品DRAM及SSD(NAND)等广泛应用，需求预测几乎每月上调

evidence.claim: 4-6月销售强劲且需求预测上调
evidence.quote: According to June 2026 data released after the July 21 close by the Semiconductor Equipment Association of Japan (SEAJ), monthly sales of Japanese semiconductor production equipment in April-June averaged ¥513.6 bn (+27% yoy, +7.0% qoq). SEAJ updated its demand forecast for Japanese semiconductor production equipment on July 2, forecasting FY3/27 sales of ¥6.55 tn (+26% yoy) and FY3/28 sales of ¥7.40 tn (+13% yoy).

evidence.claim: 前端设备需求尤其强劲
evidence.quote: Per SEAJ, whereas back-end equipment demand (centered on inspection equipment) was strong until FY3/26, front-end equipment demand is driving growth thus far in FY3/27, with strong demand across a broad range of applications, including HBM and leading-edge logic as well as commodity DRAM and SSD (NAND).

evidence.claim: 维持买入评级并上调盈利预测
evidence.quote: We retain our Buy ratings on Lasertec/Ebara/Disco/Tokyo Electron. We also revise our earnings estimates for five companies following an update to our USD/JPY assumption, from ¥155 to ¥160.

evidence.claim: 需求展望持续上调
evidence.quote: The SEAJ noted that the demand outlook is currently being revised upward almost every month, suggesting that customer requests for accelerated delivery of ordered equipment are continuing.

evidence.claim: 维持每半年加息一次且下次在2027年1月
evidence.quote: we maintain our view on roughly semi-annual rate hikes. With the policy rate being continuously raised, assessment of the economy and prices and the outlook, as well as risk assessments, are likely to become more important in future decisions on raising interest rates. Because of this, we believe the actual timing of rate hikes is more likely to be at meetings where the Outlook Report is published (January, April, July, and October), when analysis on these issues has been accumulated within the BOJ and assessments have solidified. Therefore, after the June hike, we see a high likelihood of a rate hike in January 2027, followed by July 2027.

evidence.claim: 加息可能提前至10月
evidence.quote: For this reason, we judge the probability distribution around the timing of the next rate hike to be skewed toward an earlier hike, including potentially as early as October of this year.

evidence.claim: 经济温和复苏且物价偏弱
evidence.quote: The Japanese economy is recovering moderately in line with the BOJ's outlook. Although price trends are currently somewhat weak, we expect rising upstream costs to spill over to consumer prices going forward.

research_subject: 康方生物（9926.HK）：HARMONi研究总生存期数据积极更新
executive_summary: 野村指出康方生物海外伙伴Summit于7月22日晚公布HARMONi研究额外分析，全意向治疗人群与西方患者亚组OS风险比均为0.76，较此前改善且与国内HARMONi-A相近，提升该适应症获批可能性。PDUFA行动日为2026年11月14日。野村维持买入评级，DCF目标价142.50港元，当前股价98.90港元。
key_findings: HARMONi研究全ITT及西方患者亚组OS HR均为0.76，较2025年4月0.79/0.98改善
西方患者亚组中位随访23.2个月，HR改善更明显（从0.98至0.76）
OS HR与康方中国HARMONi-A研究的0.74相近，提升获批可能性
野村维持买入评级，DCF目标价142.50港元，当前股价98.90港元

data_points.metric: 西方患者亚组中位随访
data_points.context: 首次分析9.2个月，第二次13.7个月

data_points.period: 适应症2L+ EGFRm NSCLC after 3rd gen TKI

data_points.context: 对应3.7x FY35F sales of CNY22.4bn

evidence.claim: HARMONi研究OS HR改善
evidence.quote: an additional analysis (conducted in Jun 2026) suggests that a hazard ratio (HR) of 0.76 was observed in both the full intention-to-treat (ITT) patients and the western patient subgroup, on Overall Survival (OS) of the HARMONi study.

evidence.claim: 西方患者亚组随访与历史比较
evidence.quote: Median follow-up of the western patient subgroup is 23.2 months, compared with 9.2 months and 13.7 months in the first and second analysis.

evidence.claim: 与HARMONi-A数据相近提升获批可能
evidence.quote: The Overall Survival (OS) hazard ratio (HR) of the full ITT and western patient subgroups is largely comparable to 0.74 in the HARMONi-A study conducted by Akeso in China.

evidence.claim: 维持买入评级及目标价
evidence.quote: We maintain our Buy rating and DCF-based TP of HKD142.50 (WACC of 10.8% and terminal growth rate at 4%). The stock currently trades at 3.7x FY35F sales of CNY22.4bn.

research_subject: 中国运动服饰行业：下调滔搏、宝胜国际盈利预测，以反映耐克自2027年起终止线上分销业务带来的影响
executive_summary: 高盛发布中国运动服饰行业研报，耐克自2027年1月1日起终止滔搏、宝胜国际中国内地线上分销业务，受影响业务分别占二者FY2/2026及FY2025集团收入22%和15%。高盛下调两家公司盈利预测及目标价，维持宝胜买入、滔搏中性评级。耐克渠道改革短期冲击其中国销售，给安踏、李宁等带来机会，但需警惕库存促销竞争拉低行业毛利率风险。
key_findings: 耐克2027年1月1日起终止滔搏、宝胜国际中国内地线上分销，影响收入占比22%和15%
下调滔搏FY2/27-29E销售及净利6-21%和8-35%，宝胜FY27-28E销售及净利14%和7-9%
维持宝胜买入（TP HK$0.49）、滔搏中性（TP降至HK$1.2），滔搏股息率估13%
其他品牌如安踏、李宁获市场机会，但库存处理促销或拉低行业毛利率

data_points.metric: 受影响业务占集团收入比
data_points.context: 耐克线上平台销售终止影响
反映移除耐克线上销售

evidence.claim: 耐克终止线上分销及影响占比
evidence.quote: Topsports and Pou Sheng announced that Nike will terminate the companies' online platform sales of NIKE products in ML China from January 1, 2027. The affected business represented around 22% of Topsports' FY2/2026 group revenue and 15% of Pou Sheng's FY2025 group revenue.

evidence.claim: 下调盈利预测
evidence.quote: we revise down Topsports' FY2/27-29E sales and net income by 6-21% and 8-35% respectively; and cut Pou Sheng's FY27-28E sales and net income by 14% and 7-9% respectively

evidence.claim: 评级与目标价
evidence.quote: We maintain Buy on Pou Sheng for manageable earnings impact and undemanding valuation, and Neutral on Topsports on already significant correction and attractive dividend yield of 13% on our estimates. TP for Pou Sheng is maintained at HK$0.49 and that for Topsports is cut to HK$1.2

evidence.claim: 其他品牌机会与行业风险
evidence.quote: we see opportunities for other brands given Nike's channel strategies reform will drag near-term sales and Nike remains the largest sports brands in China with c.16% market share in 2025, though we need to closely monitor the potential deteriorating promotion activities that will drag the margins.

research_subject: 中国如何缓冲全球能源供应冲击
executive_summary: 高盛分析中东冲突以来中国能源平衡，中国油气进口大降仅致经济活动温和放缓，4-5月总能源需求仍微增+0.4% YoY。三大缓冲因素：煤炭油气有效去库存贡献、燃料向煤炭可再生能源替代限制需求破坏、减产集中于油气密集行业。二季度实际GDP增速回落至3.6%季度年化（低于一季度5.3%），电动汽车普及支撑交通需求稳定。
key_findings: 中国4-5月净进口油/气/煤同比降24%/7%/24%，但总能源需求仍+0.4% YoY
有效去库存（煤/油/气）贡献总能源需求增长+3.0/+2.2/+0.2个百分点
燃料替代：油/气使用贡献-1.6/-0.1pp，煤/可再生能源贡献+1.4/+0.8pp
油气密集行业减产，乙烯等煤化工及碱、EV产出显韧性；Q2实际GDP增3.6%季度年化

data_points.metric: 中国总能源需求同比增长
data_points.context: 平均52 petajoules，进口冲击下仍正增长
库存增幅低于去年同期
交通拥堵仅微变，替代驱动
低于Q1的5.3%，受财政脉冲等影响

evidence.claim: 三大缓冲因素解释需求正增长
evidence.quote: We analyze Chinese energy balances since the start of the Middle East conflict and identify three reasons why a large hit to China's oil and natural gas imports— a key stabilizing force in LNG and especially oil markets during the Hormuz shock—led to only a moderate slowdown in overall economic activity with total energy demand growth remaining slightly positive at +0.4% YoY in April and May

evidence.claim: 有效去库存填补进口与生产缺口
evidence.quote: The bulk of the rise in total energy consumption has been driven by the effective destocking of fossil fuels.

evidence.claim: 燃料替代限制需求破坏
evidence.quote: Lower oil/natural gas use in China's overall energy demand contributed -1.6/-0.1 percentage points to its total YoY energy demand growth in April and May, while greater reliance on coal/renewables contributed +1.4/+0.8pp

evidence.claim: 减产集中于油气密集行业，其他显韧性
evidence.quote: Physical output of processed crude oil fell by 10.9% YoY in Q2 reflecting lower crude oil inputs. EV production, more reliant on power than on materials made with oil and natural gas, also increased 17.0% YoY.

executive_summary: 高盛预期中国工业科技行业二季度营收和EPS同比加速增长至18%、12%，AI基础设施和工厂自动化有望超预期。将大族激光由买入降至中性、江海股份由买入降至卖出，杭可科技升至中性，青睐汇川技术、宏发股份、创科实业等估值合理的稳健增长股。部分个股涨幅已透支基本面，需重视估值纪律，目标价调整区间-17%至+40%。
key_findings: 预期行业二季度营收和EPS同比加速至+18%/+12%（vs 1Q +16%/+5%），AI基础设施和工厂自动化或超预期

executive_summary: 伯恩斯坦基于Nielsen数据（至2026年7月11日）分析日本食品在美表现，主要品类价值增长+4.6%优于美预制食品+1.6%。龟甲万酱油增速放缓至+4%，味之素召回影响消退但冷冻米饭仍承压，养乐多恢复增长受产能限制。日清、味之素、养乐多为跑赢大盘，东洋水产、龟甲万为市场表现评级。
key_findings: 日本主要食品品类在美价值增长+4.6%（近3月）优于整体预制食品+1.6%
龟甲万酱油4周价值增长放缓至+4.4%（12周+6.3%），价格/组合软化至+0.4%
味之素整体增长弱（4周+0.2%），冷冻饺子健康+4%，冷冻米饭仍承压-9.7%
伯恩斯坦评级：日清、味之素、养乐多跑赢大盘；东洋水产、龟甲万市场表现

data_points.metric: 关键日本食品品类价值增长（近3月）
龟甲万酱油价值增长（4周）

evidence.claim: 日本食品在美整体跑赢预制食品市场
evidence.quote: Key Japanese food categories continued to outperform the overall US prepared foods market (value +4.6% vs. 1.6% over the last 3mth).

evidence.claim: 龟甲万酱油增速放缓
evidence.quote: Kikkoman Soy Sauce growth slowed from +6% (12 wks) to +4% (4wks) as price/ mix softened, and Private Label gained share.

evidence.claim: 味之素召回影响持续消退
evidence.quote: Ajinomoto's overall growth remained weak as a result of product recalls, but Frozen Dumpling growth remained healthy (+4%).

evidence.claim: 伯恩斯坦给出评级
evidence.quote: We rate: Nissin Outperform, Toyo Suisan Market-Perform, Kikkoman Market-Perform, Ajinomoto Outperform, Yakult Outperform.

executive_summary: 高盛基于7月中旬香港与新加坡路演反馈，指出投资者对日本大型银行、主要地区银行及日本邮政银行兴趣浓厚，受信贷增长加速、利率正常化及资本市场活跃驱动。城市银行贷放增速由1-3月同比+5.9%升至4-6月+8.4%。高盛维持行业建设性看法，认为中长期ROE下市净率有望达2倍或以上，一季度盈利受五大顺风支撑，仅中东局势等为下行风险。
key_findings: 投资者对megabanks、主要地区银行及日本邮政银行兴趣浓厚，因信贷增长、利率正常化与资本市场活跃
城市银行贷款增长由1-3月同比+5.9%加速至4-6月+8.4%
高盛维持银行业建设性看法，中长期ROE视角下P/B有望达2倍或更高
一季度盈利受五顺风支撑，下行风险含中东局势与长债利率上升导致的债券再平衡

data_points.metric: 五大顺风之一：利率上升
data_points.value_text: 2025年12月加息后更高按揭利率、2026年6月加息前短端利率上升、上年度JGB再平衡carry收入改善

data_points.metric: 五大顺风之一：贷款增长

data_points.value_text: TOPIX上升带来投信注销等收益

evidence.claim: 路演反馈显示投资者兴趣浓厚
evidence.quote: Investors continued to show strong interest in megabanks, major regional banks, and Japan Post Bank, given factors such as accelerating loan growth (city banks +5.9% yoy in Jan-Mar, to +8.4% yoy in Apr-Jun), the interest rate normalization outlook, and active capital markets.

evidence.claim: 维持建设性看法及P/B目标
evidence.quote: We maintain our constructive view on the banking sector, as A) we see upside toward P/B of 2X or higher coming into view from a medium- to long-term ROE perspective, and B) we expect 1Q earnings to show solid progress, driven by five tailwinds.

evidence.claim: 五大顺风因素
evidence.quote: We see the five tailwinds as: 1) rising interest rates (higher mortgage rates due to a December 2025 rate hike, the impact of higher short-term rates ahead of a June 2026 rate hike, and improved carry income from JGB rebalancing in the previous fiscal year); 2) loan growth (city banks +5.9% yoy in Jan-Mar, +8.4% yoy in Apr-Jun); 3) active capital markets; 4) the rise in the TOPIX (leading to gains on cancellation of investment trusts, etc.); and 5) FX impact.

evidence.claim: 下行风险及潜在上调
evidence.quote: On the other hand, downside risks include uncertainty over the situation in the Middle East and the possibility of bond rebalancing due to rising long-term interest rates. We see potential for upward revisions to company targets in 2Q to the extent that the aforementioned tailwinds outweigh the downside risks.

research_subject: 东盟与国台湾地区电信运营商：当前AI代币产品难成盈利增长引擎
executive_summary: 摩根大通指出东盟与台湾地区电信运营商已推出AI代币产品，但因缺乏独家合作，成功模式易被复制，收益流向消费者而非运营商，当前难成持续盈利增长引擎。自选建AI基础设施的运营商（如ST、ISAT）可受代币消费增量利好。优选运营商为ST、ADVANC、TRUE、4904、ISAT。近月多数运营商因轮动跑赢，FET半年移动收入与ICT收入分别增长6%、33%。
key_findings: 当前AI代币产品以订阅捆绑或多模型免费附赠形式提供，缺乏独家合作致易复制，难驱动运营商持续盈利增长
建有AI基础设施的运营商（ST、ISAT）可因代币消费上升获增量收入，ST拟至FY27部署11MW AI算力、资本开支最高6亿新元

research_subject: 中国连锁药房：2026年二季度同店复苏提速，行业整合深化；三大结构性顺风驱动未来增长
executive_summary: 摩根大通指出中国上市连锁药房2026年二季度同店增长加速，益丰约6%、老百姓5-6%、大参林环比加速，主要由客流驱动。行业整合推进，门店总量预计3-5年从约70万家缩至40-50万家。医保监管趋严挤压中小连锁，推动并购与加盟。头部连锁迎来整合份额提升、加盟轻资产增长、品类优化利润率韧性三大结构性顺风，行业最差时期已过。
key_findings: 2026年二季度同店增长加速：益丰约6%、老百姓5-6%、大参林环比加速，由客流而非客单价驱动
门店总量预计3-5年内从约70万家缩减至40-50万家，单店服务人口从约2000升至约3000
医保监管趋严（飞检、白名单、追溯、处方管控）挤压中小连锁，并购估值降至0.3-0.5x P/S
三大结构性顺风：整合驱动份额提升、加盟主导轻资产增长、品类优化与成本削减带来利润率韧性

data_points.value_text: 益丰约6%、老百姓5-6%、大参林环比加速
data_points.context: versus low-single-digit prints in 4Q25-1Q26，由foot traffic驱动
行业整合，单店服务人口从约2000升至约3000

data_points.metric: 加盟签约存量店转化占比

data_points.context: operating quality materially higher than 1-2 years ago

evidence.claim: 二季度同店增长因客流重新加速
evidence.quote: Same-store growth re-accelerated in 2Q26 across all three names (Yifeng ~6%, LaoBaiXing [LBX] 5-6%, Dashenlin also accelerating month-on-month), versus low-single-digit prints in 4Q25-1Q26, driven mainly by foot traffic.

evidence.claim: 门店基数将大幅缩减
evidence.quote: The store base peaked near 700k during COVID and our expert expects the figure to fall toward 400-500k (a ~1/3 reduction) over 3-5 years, lifting the average population served per store from ~2,000 toward ~3,000.

evidence.claim: 医保监管趋严推动整合
evidence.quote: tightening medical-insurance supervision (flight inspections, white-list regime, drug traceability requirement and prescription controls) is squeezing small and mid-size chains hardest, converting regulatory pressure into an M&A wave and franchise pipeline for the large chains at falling valuations (mid-small chain's P/S now is 0.3-0.5x).

evidence.claim: 三大结构性顺风
evidence.quote: We see three reinforcing structural tailwinds for leading pharmacy chains from now on: consolidation-driven market share gains, a franchise-led asset-light growth engine, and margin resilience from product category mix improvement and cost cuts.

research_subject: 中国：6月财政收入支出双双改善，土地出让收入进一步萎缩
executive_summary: 高盛指出6月中国财政预算内财政收入同比+8.7%、支出+4.0%均改善，但土地出让收入同比降42.1%进一步萎缩，广义财政赤字持续收窄。二季度财政负脉冲对实际GDP环比下滑贡献超40%，财政政策成增长拖累。预计决策层在7月政治局会议强化宽松表态、加快需求侧措施落地，提示地方执行约束风险。
key_findings: 6月财政预算内财政收入同比+8.7%（前值+6.6%），税收收入提速抵消非税放缓
6月财政支出同比+4.0%（前值-1.6%），但仍低于收入增速；土地出让收入同比-42.1%
广义财政赤字（AFD）6月继续收窄，二季度财政负脉冲贡献超40%的GDP环比下滑
预计决策层在7月政治局会议强化宽松、加速需求侧措施，风险含地方执行约束

data_points.metric: 房地产相关税收收入增长

evidence.claim: 6月财政收支双双改善但土地收入萎缩
evidence.quote: Year-on-year growth in on-budget fiscal revenue improved in June amid higher PPI inflation and mixed activity growth, as faster tax revenue growth more than offset slower non-tax revenue growth. Fiscal expenditure growth also rebounded, but it remained below fiscal revenue growth. Property-related government revenue weakened further in June, mainly due to a wider year-on-year contraction in off-budget land sales revenue.

evidence.claim: 二季度财政负脉冲拖累GDP
evidence.quote: We estimate the negative fiscal impulse contributed more than 40% of the sequential decline in real GDP growth from Q1 to Q2.

evidence.claim: 预计政策层强化宽松
evidence.quote: After weaker-than-expected Q2 GDP, we expect policymakers to strengthen easing rhetoric and pledge to accelerate implementation of planned demand-side measures at the upcoming July Politburo meeting.

evidence.claim: 上半年财政数据及风险
evidence.quote: On-budget fiscal revenue grew 4.7% yoy in H1 2026, exceeding the MOF's full-year budget projection of a 2.2% yoy gain thanks to a notable improvement in tax revenue growth amid higher global energy prices and domestic PPI inflation, while anecdotal evidence suggests that some local governments, under financial strain, have collected tax revenues more aggressively.

executive_summary: 高盛指出所覆盖券商A/H股2Q26回报率达17%/18%，进入下半年股价表现将因港股资本部署、A股科技IPO及行业并购继续分化。预测覆盖券商2026-2027平均ROE达11.2%（上调145bps），杠杆与净利润增长提升。上调12个月目标价12%-13%，维持中金H、广发A、中信A正面评级，东方财富卖出。行业并购加速头部与尾部分化。
key_findings: 覆盖券商A/H股2Q26回报17%/18%，港股资本部署、A股科技IPO及并购驱动下半年分化
预测三家覆盖券商2026-2027平均ROE达11.2%（较前期+145bps），杠杆升0.1-0.3x，净利润2Q26/2H26增68%/32%
上调覆盖券商12个月目标价12%-13%，维持中金H、广发A、中信A正面评级，东方财富卖出

data_points.metric: 中金港股业务利润贡献

data_points.context: 与东兴、信达合并，ROE不低于10%

evidence.claim: 下半年股价分化由三大因素驱动
evidence.quote: As we enter 2H26, we believe stock performance will continue to diverge, primarily driven by capital deployment in the Hong Kong market, A-share tech IPOs, and industry M&A, alongside trends in the wealth management business.

evidence.claim: ROE与盈利预期上调
evidence.quote: We forecast the average 2026-2027 ROE for our three covered brokers will reach 11.2%, a +145bps upward revision from our prior estimate due to a combination of structural factors (HK capital deployment, tech investment chain participation) and cyclical tailwinds (high A-share ADTV, IPO pipeline), compared to an 8.9% ROE in 2025.

evidence.claim: 目标价与评级调整
evidence.quote: Consequently, we raise our 12-month target prices by 12%-13%. For stock selection, we maintain our positive view on CICC-H, GFS-A, and CITICS-A.

evidence.claim: 中金并购时间表与ROE指引
evidence.quote: CICC has provided guidance that it will complete its merger with Dongxing Securities and Cinda Securities in 3Q26. Upon completion, CICC's total equity will increase by 50% to Rmb 186bn per the company. According to management guidance, the post-merger ROE will be no less than 10%.

executive_summary: 高盛指出中国CDMO板块过去一月涨27.9%领跑医疗反弹，订单韧性支撑估值重估。GLP-1、ADC需求及全球并购、AI药物研发带来增量催化，地缘影响有限。高盛对覆盖企业FY26-28调整后净利润预期分别上调5%/10%/6%，平均上调目标价5%，维持药明康德、凯莱英等评级，建议聚焦二季度订单转化与盈利指引。

source_title: 伯恩斯坦-简评：耐克削减中国经销商线上销售权限-260722.pdf
research_subject: 耐克削减中国经销商线上销售权限对TopSports和Pou Sheng的影响
executive_summary: 耐克正削减中国两大分销合作伙伴TopSports和Pou Sheng的线上供货，将于2027年1月起停止通过分销商运营的线上门店进行销售。线上业务分别占两家合作伙伴中国营收的22%和15%。该举措是耐克清理中国低质量线上销售、维护高端运动品牌形象的一部分，线下销售及官方旗舰店线上销售不受影响。该调整将导致耐克中国2027财年上半年营收下滑teens比例，对整体营收造成约2-3个点的压力。
key_findings: Nike将自2027年1月起消除通过分销商运营线上门店的在线销售
Topsports中国营收中Nike线上占比约22%，Pou Sheng约15%
耐克中国2027财年上半年营收预计下滑teens比例，整体承压2-3个点

data_points.metric: Nike线上占中国营收比例（Pou Sheng）
耐克中国H1 FY27营收下滑
data_points.context: 中国guided to decline at a teens rate for H1 FY27
implies pressure of ~2-3 opts on top line sales

evidence.claim: 耐克停止分销商线上门店销售的时间与范围
evidence.quote: Nike will eliminate online sales through distributor-operated storefronts beginning in January 2027.

evidence.claim: Topsports中国营收中Nike线上占比
evidence.quote: Topsports disclosed that Nike online represents ~22% of their China revenue

evidence.claim: 调整对耐克整体营收的压力
evidence.quote: China is guided to decline at a teens rate for H1 FY27 as a result of this lower sell-in. At 12% of the total business, this implies pressure of ~2-3 opts on top line sales in the coming quarters.

evidence.claim: 达成共识需核心客户芯片收入高增
evidence.quote: To meet consensus and our estimate, Horizon needs to grow chip-driven revenue by over 80% YoY, to which sales expansion in Li, BYD, Geely and Chery would be crucial.

evidence.claim: 评级与目标价
evidence.quote: Current given Overweight rating, target price HK$8.7.

research_subject: 通用汽车（GM.N）：超预期、上调指引、循环往复
executive_summary: 摩根士丹利指出通用汽车二季度业绩超预期，上调2026年EBIT指引至140亿-160亿美元，并提供2027年约160亿美元初步方向。目标价由100美元上调至101美元，维持增持评级。软件、国防及储能等非汽车业务是估值重评核心动力，23亿美元EV相关费用落地消除资本回报不确定性。
key_findings: 2Q EBIT超预期，GMNA EBIT比预期高8%，2026 EBIT指引中点上调5亿美元至140-160亿美元
2027年初步方向指向约160亿美元调整后EBIT，由EV盈利改善、数字收入等驱动
软件业务递延收入达63亿美元（+50% y/y），年底料达75亿美元，2027年双位数增长且毛利率70%
EV相关费用23亿美元落地消除资本回报不确定性，目标价由100升至101美元，维持增持

data_points.context: 消除资本回报不确定性

evidence.claim: 业绩超预期且上调指引
evidence.quote: GM delivered a clean 2Q beat and raised 2026 EBIT guidance, while offering positive preliminary commentary on the 2027 outlook.

evidence.claim: 软件业务为低估增长驱动
evidence.quote: In 2Q, deferred revenue reached $6.3bn (+50% y/y) and is on track to reach $7.5bn by year-end, supporting double-digit realized revenue growth in 2027 at ~70% gross margins.

evidence.claim: EV费用消除资本回报不确定性
evidence.quote: GM substantially completed the review of its EV business, resulting in an incremental $2.3bn charge in the quarter. While the company has been clear about its commitment to its capital return program, we believe the conclusion of their EV business review helps remove a lingering overhang around the capital return opportunity at GM

evidence.claim: 目标价与评级
evidence.quote: Our PT increases to $101, primarily driven by a lower share count.

research_subject: 华明装备（002270.SZ）：回调后估值具备吸引力，全球电网升级驱动海外增长韧性不变，上调至“买入”评级
executive_summary: 高盛将华明装备评级由中性上调至买入，12个月目标价23.9元对应33%上行空间。股价自2026年初回调36%（峰值至谷底52%），当前18.1倍远期PE低于历史均值20.3倍。全球电网升级、老化改造及新能源并网驱动海外增长，预计2026E-30E净利润CAGR达17%，海外OLTC营收占比从41%升至59%，全球份额13%升至16%。
key_findings: 评级由中性上调至买入，12个月目标价23.9元（未变）对应33%上行空间
2026年初至今股价回调36%，峰值至谷底跌52%，当前18.1x 12个月远期PE低于历史均值20.3x
全球电网投资24-35E CAGR 7%，海外OLTC营收占比从41%(2026E)升至59%(2030E)，全球份额13%升至16%
预计2026E-30E营收CAGR 14%、净利润CAGR 17%，毛利率由56%升至57.5%；三大下行风险为海外份额、利润率、国内营收不及预期

data_points.context: 对应33%上行空间，评级由中性上调至买入
依托质量、交期与价格优势

evidence.claim: 上调评级基于回调后估值吸引力
evidence.quote: We upgrade Huaming from Neutral to Buy on valuation, as the 33% upside to our unchanged 12-month target price of Rmb23.9 underscores an attractive risk-reward.

evidence.claim: 股价回调幅度及估值低于历史均值
evidence.quote: Since the beginning of the 2026 stock has corrected 36%, including a deeper drawdown of 52% peak-to-trough compared to peers such as Sieyuan and Yingliu

evidence.claim: 海外增长由全球电网升级驱动且韧性不变
evidence.quote: Despite this reset in expectations and limited direct exposure to the U.S. power shortage, we believe Huaming's overseas growth ex-U.S. remains intact. Siemens Energy/Hitachi Energy forecast global grid investment to grow at a 7% CAGR over 2024-35E, driven not only by data center build-out but also by aging infrastructure and renewable integration.

evidence.claim: 盈利与份额预测及护城河
evidence.quote: We expect export contribution within the OLTC business to rise from 41% in 2026E to 59% by 2030E. Its competitive moat is reinforced by the mission-critical nature of tap changers, long customer qualification cycles, high switching costs and a structurally duopolistic global market.

research_subject: 长飞光纤光缆（6869.HK）：中国产能扩张将迅速抹平供给缺口；下调评级至“持有”
executive_summary: 杰富瑞指出AI及军事冲突带动光纤需求上涨，长飞光纤光缆光纤ASP及毛利率将大幅提升，2026年EPS预计同比涨10倍，但中国及全球产能大幅扩张将快速抹平供给缺口，2026年或成ASP峰值。基于SOTP估值法得出目标价142港元，较此前上调8%但上行空间仅9%，因此将评级由买入下调至持有。
key_findings: AI需求及军事冲突带动光纤需求，公司光纤ASP及毛利率将大幅提升，2026年EPS预计同比涨10倍
中国及全球产能大幅扩张将快速抹平供给缺口，2026年或成ASP峰值，全球产能2028年增69%（中国翻倍）
基于SOTP估值法目标价142港元，较此前上调8%但上行空间仅9%，评级由买入下调至持有
公司是唯一未讨论扩产计划的主要玩家，或面临份额流失风险，但出口与光模块多元化策略稳健

data_points.context: 受AI需求驱动，预制棒+光纤毛利率2026年升至86%（2025年48%）
基于官宣扩产及12-18个月建设期，2027/28年全球产能覆盖需求87%/85%
SOTP估值，光纤业务按3.5x PB与14.1x 2027E PE均值
单位生产成本未显著变化，含电缆的综合毛利率由31%升至53%

data_points.metric: 数据中心光纤需求占比

evidence.claim: AI需求驱动价格上涨但供给将快速过剩
evidence.quote: YOFC has risen ~14x in the past 12 months due to AI-driven growth in demand for OF and optical modules. We estimate its OF ASP will rise 203% in 2026 to Rmb146/fkm, ~18% above the previous peak in 2018. But we estimate global capacity will expand 69% by 2028 (100% in China), and more could come. Thus 2026 ASP would likely be the peak.

evidence.claim: 毛利率飙升而EPS大幅增长
evidence.quote: Since the unit cost of production has not changed materially, we est YOFC's GM on its preform+OF segment will rise from 48% in 2025 to 86% in 2026. Given high operating leverage, we forecast a 10x YoY rise in EPS this year to Rmb11.44, implying 11x 2026E PE currently.

evidence.claim: 产能扩张抹平缺口导致评级下调
evidence.quote: Based on announced expansion plans and 12-18 months of buildout time, we estimate global capacity will increase 69% from now to 2028, with China's capacity doubling. YOFC is the only major player that has not discussed any expansion plan. Our new PT is based on an avg SOTP, with the OF business valued at the avg of 3.5x PB and 14.1x 2027E PE, and implies only 9% upside. D/G to HOLD.

evidence.claim: 数据中心需求结构变化
evidence.quote: Datacom had been 10% of OF demand (80% telecom) until 2024. We est datacom will be 43% of demand in 2026 rising to 55% in 2027, implying 131%/65% YoY growth.

research_subject: 中国物流、快递快运与电商行业复苏与2Q26业绩前瞻
executive_summary: 中国物流行业正推进提质增效驱动的温和复苏，6月行业收入同比增7.7%超件量3.8%增速，ASP回升至7.77元，反内卷举措推动定价理性与利润率修复。通达系2Q26净利润增速分别提升至92%、152%、136%。满帮与极兔成为板块下一阶段首选标的，中通、京东物流、顺丰紧随其后。行业逐步脱离“以量换价”模式，向可持续毛利驱动增长转型。
key_findings: 行业收入6月同比增7.7%，件量增3.8%，ASP为7.77元
通达系2Q26净利润YOY加速至92%、152%、136%
满帮与极兔领跑，JDL目标价降至17港元，YMM升至11美元

evidence.claim: 行业温和复苏与ASP回升
evidence.quote: The improvement was underpinned by sector revenue growth of 7.7% Y/Y (vs. volume +3.8% Y/Y), ongoing ASP recovery (Rmb7.77, +3.8% Y/Y)

evidence.claim: 通达系2Q26利润加速
evidence.quote: with implied 2Q26 net profit growth for YTO, STO, and Yunda accelerating to 92%, 152%, and 136% Y/Y, respectively.

evidence.claim: 满帮与极兔成为首选
evidence.quote: YMM and J&T now lead our top picks, followed by ZTO, JD Logistics, and SF (all OW).

research_subject: 露露乐蒙（LULU.US）：减持逻辑拆解：“收缩求增长”将是下一阶段主线
executive_summary: 摩根士丹利给予露露乐蒙减持评级，认为其美洲业务规模显著超出可持续营收基数，新管理层大概率采取“收缩求增长”策略，带来更长期调整与负面盈利修正。三大独立框架显示美洲业务约30-65亿美元，远低于市场70亿+预期。大摩预测低个位数增长、EPS约10-11美元，低于共识中个位数及12美元，基于DCF给93美元目标价。
key_findings: 三大框架显示美洲业务约$3-6.5B，远低于共识2026-2028e的$7B+预期
大摩认为新管理层将采取“收缩求增长”策略，导致更长美洲重置与负面EPS修正

research_subject: 日本政府养老投资基金（GPIF）的三大核心疑问
executive_summary: 摩根士丹利与摩根大通均探讨GPIF潜在配置调整影响。若将国内债券与日股配比提至31%上限，约33.8万亿日元日元买入/外币卖出，或推动美元兑日元下行约15日元，但资金流更平缓。正式组合修订更可能在2027年3月财年末，短期其他日本投资者跟进回流可能性低。关键监测为GPIF季度报告与月度流动数据。
key_findings: GPIF国内债券配比26.91%、日股23.81%（截至2026年3月底），提至31%上限将产生约33.8万亿日元日元买入
基于4-5月干预基准，33.8万亿日元或推动USD/JPY下行约15日元，但流动更平缓分散
正式基本组合修订更可能在2027年3月财年末，中期修订无先例、时间线高度不确定
其他日本投资者（如寿险）短期跟进回流本土资产可能性低，持有约100万亿日元海外证券、对冲比约40%

data_points.metric: 潜在日元买入/外币卖出总额
data_points.context: 国内债券与日股均提至31%
基于4-5月干预基准简单外推
季度业绩报告为关键监测指标

entities: 日本政府养老投资基金

evidence.claim: 配置调整潜在市场影响
evidence.quote: Even within the existing framework, a reallocation to the upper band of both domestic bonds and Japanese equities (both to 31%) could generate ~JPY 33.8tn of yen buying/foreign-currency selling—implying potential USD/JPY downside of ~15 yen, though flows are expected to be more gradual and dispersed compared to a concentrated intervention episode.

evidence.claim: 组合变更时间线
evidence.quote: The most immediate step would be utilising the existing band within the current basic portfolio, which could be enacted at any time. Any revision to the basic portfolio itself, however, is more likely to be implemented at the fiscal year-end in March 2027.

evidence.claim: 其他日本投资者跟进可能性低
evidence.quote: While repatriation has been a long-standing theme in Japan, a swift follow-through from other real money investors in the wake of any GPIF shift appears unlikely.

evidence.claim: 关键监测数据
evidence.quote: In terms of monitoring actual flows, the quarterly GPIF performance report will be a key indicator to watch. This report is typically released on the first Friday two months after each quarter-end; following this schedule, the next release is expected on August 7th, covering April-June 2026 data, followed by November 6th, covering July-September 2026 data.

executive_summary: 花旗指出中国医疗健康行业2026年上半年业绩分化：CDMO板块表现稳健，领先企业有望超预期；药企部分靠对外授权支撑利润，但反腐持续扰动医院渠道销售；医疗器械海外增长强劲、国内不一；消费医疗偏软；流通与医院端受医保预算控制承压。报告给出30/90天催化剂观察名单，正面含药明生物、药明康德等，负面含平安好医、威高、联影。
key_findings: CDMO/CRO板块业绩确认强劲，药明康德、药明系、康龙化成、泰格医药等有望超预期或指引上调
药企板块对外授权交易对冲销售压力，中生制药、翰森靠首付款beat，恒瑞营收miss但利润受Kailera IPO收益缓冲
医疗器械海外为增长引擎、国内分化；流通与医院端受医保预算控制承压，消费医疗子板块整体偏软
花旗开启90天下行催化剂观察：华东医药、平安好医、威高；上行观察：泰格、药明康德、益丰药房

evidence.quote: We expect leading CDMO companies may see beat in 1H25, resting on strong backlog growth. Some leading pharmas/biopharma to miss revenue in 1H26, despite episodic BD/out-licensing deals providing bottom-line support.

evidence.claim: 器械、流通、消费医疗表现
evidence.quote: Medical device names are likely to see mixed results – key factors are FX loss impact and domestic ASP pressure. Hospitals and distribution continue to face headwinds from strict medical insurance budget control. Consumer-facing sub-sectors — Medical Aesthetics, Healthcare Services, and TCM — remained broadly soft in 1H26.

evidence.claim: 90天催化剂观察名单
evidence.quote: See 30/90-day catalyst watches: +ve: WuXi Bio / WuXi AppTec/ Pharmaron/ Tigermed/ SBP/ MicroPort Medbot/ Yifeng; -ve: PagD, Weigao, United Imaging.

evidence.claim: 华东医药下行催化观察
evidence.quote: We open a 90-day Downside Catalyst Watch on Huadong Medicines. The key catalyst is its upcoming 1H26 results, which could miss consensus as the company proactively destocked distribution channels on GPO pressure.

research_subject: 中国半导体设备进口追踪：2026年6月同比微降1%
executive_summary: 美银全球研究追踪中国海关半导体设备进口数据，2026年6月进口额47亿美元，同比降1%、环比升45%，YTD降9%。前端设备6月同比微增1%、环比升57%；光刻机环比暴增184%，线焊机同比增153%。中国占2025年全球晶圆制造设备市场33.5%，是最大区域市场，多数设备商预计2026年中国销售正常化。
key_findings: 6月中国半导体设备进口额47亿美元，同比降1%、环比升45%，YTD降9%
前端设备6月进口34亿美元，同比增1%、环比增57%，热处理/其他前端/过程控制/光刻同比正增
线焊机6月进口同比大增153%，为后端唯一正增品类；组装封装同比降6%
前五大设备商披露中国销售额占中国前端进口额65%-85%，进口数据可追踪全球厂商中国销售

data_points.metric: 中国半导体设备进口额
data_points.context: 同比降1%、环比升45%；前3月均值为$3.9bn
全球半导体设备厂商最重要市场之一
后端各品类多数同比下跌，仅线焊机正增
多数设备商预计中国销售正常化

evidence.claim: 6月进口同比微降环比大增
evidence.quote: China's semiconductor equipment imports were $4.7bn in June 2026, above the previous 3mth (Mar'26-May'26) average of $3.9bn and above the previous 12mth (Jun'25-May'26) average of $4.4bn. Import value was down 1% yoy and up 45% mom.

evidence.claim: 中国为全球最大设备市场
evidence.quote: China accounted for 33.5% of global WFE in 2025, making it one of the most important regions for global semicaps.

evidence.claim: 前端设备细分同比表现分化
evidence.quote: China imported $3.4bn worth of front-end equipment in June. Front-end imports were up 1% yoy and up 57% mom, driven primarily by Heat treatment ($188mm; +78% yoy/+42% mom), Other Front-end ($488mm; +48% yoy/+104% mom), Process control ($444mm; +24% yoy/+41% mom) and Lithography ($5842mm; +3% yoy/+184% mom), while other segments were down

evidence.claim: 前五大供应商占比及数据有效性
evidence.quote: The top 5 semicap suppliers disclosed China sales accounted for 65%-85% of China's front-end equipment imports, and the import data can be used as an effective reference indicator to track the China sales trend of global semicap suppliers.

research_subject: 霸王茶姬（CHA.US）2026年二季度业绩前瞻：下调目标价与盈利预测
executive_summary: 花旗预测霸王茶姬2Q26E集团同店GMV同比降约15%，非GAAP净利润环比持平、同比降约20%。将2026/2027年非GAAP净利润预测下调25%/30%，DCF目标价由24.6美元降至15.2美元。维持买入/高风险评级，预计2H26E同店GMV跌幅收窄，2028年预测为新引入。风险含行业竞争、运营历史短等。
key_findings: 2Q26E同店GMV同比降约15%，非GAAP NP环比持平、同比降约20%，中国月均GMV per store约Rmb350k+
2026/2027年非GAAP NP预测下调25%/30%，DCF目标价由US$24.6降至US$15.2
维持Buy/High Risk评级，预计2H26E同店GMV同比跌幅逐步收窄，4Q26E转正
中国加盟商转GMV分成模式，费率更高但毛利影响有限；2026年中国净开店重设至~300

evidence.claim: 业绩前瞻与预测
evidence.quote: We forecast Chagee's group same-store GMV to decline by ~15% YoY in 2Q26E, rough in line with that in 1Q26 (-16.0% YoY). We expect its 2Q26E non-GAAP NP to be largely flat QoQ (vs. Rmb507m in 1Q26) and down ~20% YoY.

evidence.claim: 目标价与盈利预测下调
evidence.quote: We lower our 2026E/27E non-GAAP NP forecasts by 25%/30% and cut our DCF-based target price to US$15.2 (from US$24.6); we also introduce 2028E estimates.

evidence.claim: 评级与恢复预期
evidence.quote: We maintain our Buy/High Risk rating on Chagee. We expect its YoY decline in same-store GMV to sequentially improve in 2H26E, on a low comp base (due to its reluctance to participate in delivery platforms' subsidy war in 2H25).

evidence.claim: 商业模式转变
evidence.quote: Since 2026, its China franchisees switched to a GMV-based revenue-sharing model, where Chagee takes a higher fee rate but reduces its markup on sales to franchisees. Financially, this has limited impact on its GPM.

evidence.claim: 毛利率改善由降本驱动
evidence.quote: Ms. Xiao indicated that cost reduction was the key reason leading to GPM expansion. In addition, Estun reduced its reliance on big clients BYD (1211.HK) and CATL (300750.SZ / 3750.HK), lowering revenue from the two customers from ~Rmb800mn in 1H25 to ~Rmb400mn in 1H26.

evidence.claim: 2026年指引可达成

evidence.claim: 库卡为潜在威胁
evidence.quote: the imminent threat on the industrial robot side could be from KUKA (unlisted), which has been aggressively localizing its component supplies in order to make its products more price competitive.

evidence.claim: 花旗偏好减速器厂商并给予埃斯顿卖出

research_subject: 地平线机器人（9660.HK）：预计上半年毛利率超65%，三大催化剂推动均值回归
executive_summary: 花旗预计地平线机器人上半年毛利率超65%、营收同比增超34%，净利因可转债公允价值变动转正。报告给出三大催化剂：全球车企L3/L4合作、比亚迪份额提升、英伟达在华ADAS份额流失，推动估值均值回归。给予买入/高风险评级，目标价12.3港元，较现价4.45港元有176.4%预期回报，并提示多项风险。
key_findings: 花旗预计1H26营收同比增超34%至上限，毛利率65-66%，调整后净亏约15亿元
三大催化剂：与全球车企L3/L4合作、比亚迪份额提升、英伟达在华ADAS份额流失
给予买入/高风险评级，目标价12.3港元，预期回报176.4%，基于2030E 30倍PE贴现
提示有限运营历史、研发不确定性、竞争监管、供应链依赖、客户集中、地缘政治等风险

data_points.context: due to blended ASP increase and cost reduction from 7nm chips
Price HK$4.45, Expected share price return 176.4%
considering fair value reversal of convertible loans

evidence.claim: 上半年业绩与毛利率预期
evidence.quote: We expect 1H26 operating revenue to hit guidance upper-range at >34% YoY given its market share gain amid rollout of full-scenario NOA solutions. (2) 1H26 GPM should hit upper-range at 65-66% due to blended ASP increase from market share/mix gain, as well as cost reduction due to 7nm chips' controllable environments.

evidence.claim: 三大催化剂推动均值回归
evidence.quote: Catalysts: (1) We expect Horizon may announce L3/L4 cooperation plan with major global auto makers, which may generate billions of RMB IP income in the next 3 years with 95% GPM. (2) We expect Horizon to further expand its market share via penetrating into BYD God's Eye C (wallet share hiking to 90-100%) and Eye B solutions (wallet share also to rise) in 2H26—we recognize a major reason for Horizon Robotics' previous share price decline was due to investors' concerns on its wallet shares within BYD. (3) NVIDIA's hardware market share loss in China ADAS market would potentially harm its platform-related software makers, which could improve Horizon Robotics competitiveness.

evidence.claim: 评级与目标价
evidence.quote: We derive our target price of HK$12.3 (HK$179.8bn market cap). The market cap of Horizon Robotics now (US$8.3bn) is close to Mobileye at US$7.5bn (while Mobileye has no AD, but only has ADAS); we believe the market has not factored in Horizon Robotics' autonomous driving (AD) business, as well as its market share gain results, and 2H26 China EV growth seasonality and the 3 catalysts we mentioned above.

evidence.claim: 高风险提示
evidence.quote: We rate Horizon Robotics High Risk given its limited operating history and current loss-making status. Key downside risks that could impede the shares from reaching our target price include: (1) limited operating history; (2) uncertain R&D outcomes; (3) competition and regulatory risk; (4) risk on supply chain dependency; (5) customer concentration risk; (6) geopolitical and compliance risks; and (7) market adoption uncertainty.

executive_summary: 花旗指出中国逆变器出口6月加速，出口额同比+34.1%至12.3亿美元，环比+30.3%，受澳洲、非洲、亚洲及欧洲需求提升带动。浙江、安徽产区表现分化。太阳能组件出口额同比+11.9%但量降24.2%。阳光电源提出5-10亿元回购，德业控股股东拟每股1.6元中期分红，花旗在光伏与储能板块偏好二者。
key_findings: 6月中国逆变器出口额同比+34.1%、环比+30.3%至12.3亿美元，1H26累计+30.0%至55.35亿美元

evidence.claim: 逆变器出口加速且区域分化
evidence.quote: Export growth of China inverter products further accelerated in June, with export value +34.1% yoy and +30.3% mom to US$1,230m, from +13.7% yoy in May, boosted by strong global demand, in particular in Australia and Africa. By major shipping origins, monthly inverter exports from Anhui province, where Sungrow is headquartered, was +8.8% yoy to US$120m in June, while that from Zhejiang province, where Deye is headquartered, was +103.6% yoy to US$405m.

evidence.claim: 组件出口量降价升
evidence.quote: China solar module export value increased 11.9% yoy and 20.2% mom to US$2,150m in June, mainly due to increased average unit price, while the export volume was -24.2% yoy but +16.7% mom to 16.4GW, in our estimate, mainly due to cut demand from South America and Europe.

evidence.claim: 阳光电源与德业加码股东回报
evidence.quote: Today, Sungrow's chairman proposed a share buyback of Rmb500-1,000m and Deye's controlling shareholder proposed interim dividend of Rmb1.6/share to boost shareholder returns.

evidence.claim: 花旗偏好阳光电源与德业
evidence.quote: In the PRC solar and ESS sector, we prefer Sungrow and Deye, benefiting from strong global energy storage demand growth.

research_subject: 美的集团（0300.HK）：2026年下半年前景向好，股东回报强劲
executive_summary: 美银证券维持美的集团H股和A股买入评级，分别给出101.60港元和96元人民币目标价，认为2026年下半年前景向好，全年收入中高个位数增长且核心利润率趋稳。长期增长受益2B业务与海外布局，当前股东回报强劲，含100%派息率及回购，潜在投资收益或带来额外分红。风险提示行业周期、关税及执行不力。
key_findings: 美银维持H/A股买入评级，目标价101.60港元/96元人民币，看好2H26改善、2B及海外多元化、强劲股东回报
预计2026全年收入中高个位数增长、核心利润率基本稳定，1H26进度落后但2H26有望追赶
2B业务1H26预计中个位数增长，储能与库卡优于平均；2C中国/海外2Q26预计-中个位数/+中个位数
股东回报含100%派息率及股份回购，记忆体公司投资公允价值变动或带来特别分红

data_points.context: 潜在投资收益带来额外分红上行
储能与库卡优于平均，工业方案拖累

evidence.claim: 评级与目标价及下半年展望
evidence.quote: BofA preview – revenue +LSD-MSD driven by overseas and 2B (partly offset by likely domestic 2C declines), core NPAT -MSD on cost and FX losses, and reported NPAT up YoY after factoring in investment gains as well as impairment charges. We reiterate Buy rating due to 1) improving outlook in 2H26, 2) diversification into 2B and overseas to support long-term growth and valuation, and 3) solid shareholder returns (100% payout ratios including share buyback, with potential upside from investment gains)

evidence.claim: 全年指引与上半年追赶预期
evidence.quote: Midea guides for MSD-HSD revenue growth and largely stable core margins in FY26. We estimate that its 1H26 run rate is tracking behind schedule, but see potential for a catch-up in 2H26.

evidence.claim: 2B与2C分部趋势
evidence.quote: 2) 2B. We estimate 2B growth to be +MSD in 1H26 and expect similar or faster trends in 2H26. Historically, 2B enjoyed >10% growth but FY26 growth could be below-trend given the drag from Industrial Solution (components for 2C) and a high base of Intelligent Building. Energy Storage and Kuka should outperform the 2B average.

evidence.claim: 投资损益与股东回报上行
evidence.quote: We expect Midea to book mark-to-market fair value changes from its investment in memory companies since 2Q, and see likely meaningful gains in 2Q/3Q26. Some of these gains may likely be offset by impairment charges. While the investment is subject to a one-year lock-up period, we expect Midea to monetize the stake following the lock-up expiry in 2027. We also see the potential for the associated proceeds to be returned to shareholders through special dividends or other shareholder return initiatives.

research_subject: 日本电子元件行业
executive_summary: 瑞银指出2026年是日本电子元件行业从传统应用转向AI受益领域的转型拐点，此前行业与智能手机、PC、汽车等传统应用关联度高，AI利好正实质性影响基板、电容器、硬盘、功率半导体等细分领域。内存价格上涨压制中低端传统应用需求，高端应用保持稳健。行业市值占比与估值均处低位，推荐村田、Ibiden等已受益AI且估值合理的企业，对京瓷、广濑电机等持中性。
key_findings: 2026年为行业转型拐点，从传统应用导向转向AI受益领域，AI利好开始实质影响基板、电容器、硬盘、功率半导体等子领域

key_findings: 三重转型（免费增值、领导层、再投资）叠加推高执行风险，ARR加速路径不清
利润率近峰值，免费增值与AI使用拖累短期毛利，经营杠杆上行空间有限
估值约12倍CY27 GAAP P/E，下调PT至240美元（9倍FY27 EPS 27.23美元）

evidence.claim: 三重转型推高执行风险
evidence.quote: Three concurrent transitions (freemium GTM, CEO/CFO transition, AI reinvestment) raise execution risk & further obscure path to ARR stabilization / acceleration

evidence.claim: 目标价基于9倍FY27 EPS
evidence.quote: We lower our price target to $240 (from $365 previously) as we now apply a 9x multiple (vs. 13x previously, still a discount to Adobe's historical average) to our FY27 earnings/share estimate of ~$27.23.
